name: glb-designer-stage1b
description: Asset Studio Stage 1b — CSG v2 non-destructive booleans. In Pro with glbDesigner on: build a Box, add a Cylinder, position + rotate it to punch straight through the box on Z, mark it as a Hole (Type toggle), multi-select both (Select mode) and Subtract → a non-destructive 'Combine 1 · subtract' group whose result renders as a box with a visible circular hole (asserted: the group's Bake button becomes enabled ONLY when the evaluated result is non-degenerate). Then re-select the cylinder and slide the hole sideways via a numeric position edit, asserting re-evaluation (Bake re-enables). Then add three boxes, multi-union them into 'Combine 2 · union', and Bake that group into one 'mesh' part. Finally save and assert the persisted UserGltfDef's assetSpec embeds combineGroups + the subtract op + the hole role (the non-destructive graph survived the round-trip, so re-opening restores editability). Screenshots the decisive frames.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: verify-flag-on
steps.failMessage: glbDesigner is a pro-tier flag → on in Pro mode by default

steps.name: position-cylinder-through-box
steps.comment: The cylinder is auto-selected. Rotate it 90° about X (axis → Z) and lengthen it so it pierces the box's front+back faces; centre it on the box (x=0,z=0). Numeric edits round-trip through updatePart.
steps.eval: (function(){ const set = (label, val) => { const inp = document.querySelector(`.glb-designer input[aria-label="${label}"]`); if (!inp) throw new Error('missing input: ' + label); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(inp), 'value').set; setter.call(inp, String(val)); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); }; set('cylinder position X', 0); set('cylinder position Y', 0.2); set('cylinder position Z', 0); set('cylinder rotation X', 90); set('cylinder size Y', 0.8); })()

steps.name: mark-cylinder-hole
steps.comment: Click the Hole button in the cylinder's Type toggle — it becomes a translucent ghost.
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Hole' && b.closest('[role=radiogroup]')); if (!btn) throw new Error('Hole toggle not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-hole-badge
steps.failMessage: marking the cylinder as a Hole should show a Hole badge on its layer row

steps.name: enter-select-mode
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer button')].find(b => /^Select$/.test(b.textContent.trim())); if (!btn) throw new Error('Select mode toggle not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: select-box-and-cylinder
steps.comment: In Select mode, click the box row (adds it) — the cylinder is already selected — so both operands are picked.
steps.eval: (function(){ const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer .lyr-row')]; const boxRow = rows.find(r => /box 1/i.test(r.textContent || '')); if (!boxRow) throw new Error('box row not found'); boxRow.click(); })()

steps.name: click-subtract
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = document.querySelector('.glb-designer button[aria-label="Subtract selected parts"]'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Subtract button not found'); if (btn.disabled) throw new Error('Subtract disabled — need 2 free parts selected'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-subtract-group-ready
steps.comment: The combine records a group and evaluates it OFF the main thread; the Bake button enables ONLY when the result is a real (non-degenerate) mesh — i.e. the box-with-hole rendered.
steps.failMessage: the subtract group should evaluate to a non-degenerate box-with-hole (Bake enables)

steps.name: reselect-cylinder
steps.eval: (function(){ const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer .lyr-row')]; const row = rows.find(r => /cylinder 2/i.test(r.textContent || '')); if (!row) throw new Error('cylinder row not found'); row.click(); })()

steps.name: move-the-hole
steps.comment: Slide the hole sideways — a live re-evaluation of the same group (non-destructive: the operand moved, the result follows).
steps.eval: (function(){ const inp = document.querySelector('.glb-designer input[aria-label="cylinder position X"]'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(inp), 'value').set; setter.call(inp, '0.12'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()

steps.name: assert-reeval-ready
steps.failMessage: moving the hole should re-evaluate the group to a fresh non-degenerate result

steps.name: select-three-boxes
steps.comment: Multi-select the three new boxes (3/4/5) via shift-click MouseEvents (additive without depending on Select-mode re-render) for a multi-union.
steps.eval: (function(){ const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer .lyr-row')]; const row = (nm) => { const r = rows.find(x => new RegExp(nm,'i').test(x.textContent || '')); if (!r) throw new Error('missing row: ' + nm); return r; }; row('box 3').click(); row('box 4').dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, shiftKey: true })); row('box 5').dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, shiftKey: true })); })()

steps.name: click-union
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = document.querySelector('.glb-designer button[aria-label="Union selected parts"]'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Union button not found'); if (btn.disabled) throw new Error('Union disabled'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-union-group-ready
steps.failMessage: the three-box union (Combine 2) should evaluate to a non-degenerate result

steps.name: bake-union-group
steps.comment: Bake Combine 2 (the union) into one frozen 'mesh' part — the three source boxes collapse into a single editable-position mesh.
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = document.querySelector('.glb-designer button[aria-label="Bake Combine 2 to a mesh"]'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Bake button not found'); if (btn.disabled) throw new Error('Bake disabled'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-baked-mesh-row
steps.comment: After baking the union, a single 'mesh' layer row exists and the part count dropped (3 boxes → 1 mesh).
steps.failMessage: baking a combine group should produce one 'mesh' layer row

steps.name: assert-part-count-dropped
steps.eval: (function(){ const now = document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer button[aria-label^="Remove "]').length; if (!(now < window.__partsBefore)) throw new Error('baking should reduce the part count, before=' + window.__partsBefore + ' after=' + now); })()

steps.name: set-asset-name
steps.eval: (function(){ const inp = document.querySelector('.glb-designer input[aria-label="Asset name"]'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(inp), 'value').set; setter.call(inp, 'Stage1b CSG'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()

steps.name: click-save
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Save asset' && !b.disabled); if (!btn) throw new Error('Save asset button not found or disabled'); btn.scrollIntoView(); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-saved-spec-carries-combine-graph
steps.comment: End-to-end proof: the saved UserGltfDef's assetSpec JSON embeds the non-destructive combine graph — a combineGroups array, the subtract op, and the hole role — so re-opening restores editability with the op intact.

waitFor.store: state.userFurniture.length > window.__glbBaseline && state.userFurniture.some(d => d.name === 'Stage1b CSG' && typeof d.assetSpec === 'string' && d.assetSpec.includes('combineGroups') && d.assetSpec.includes('"subtract"') && d.assetSpec.includes('"role":"hole"'))

steps.failMessage: saved assetSpec should embed combineGroups + the subtract op + the hole role
